context_requirements: Expression of the specific diuretic target (e.g., SLC12A1/NKCC2, SLC12A3/NCC, SLC12A2/NKCC1, or epithelial sodium channel) at sufficient levels
An intact downstream signaling pathway that can be modulated transcriptionally within 6-24 h
Cellular osmotic or ionic stress that is not buffered by compensatory mechanisms
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h that are shared across multiple diuretic drugs and absent with vehicle
Enrichment of a specific transcriptional signature (e.g., NFAT/tonicity-responsive genes) in treated versus vehicle wells
Line-dependent responses that correlate with expression of a known diuretic target
